text:
harper: opened PR to refresh the welcome flow for new users — fixes SDK7 auth snippet, corrects docker run ports, and replaces a dead KMS link. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/527

diego: nice. which KMS link was dead?

harper: it pointed to /docs/kms-legacy. should go to /docs/integrations/kms now.

sue: CI failed snippet-check: python snippet still uses RW_API_KEY and old import.

harper: failing snippet:

harper: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("RW_API_KEY"))
```

ivy: swap to SDK7 style and REDWOOD_API_KEY:

ivy: ```python
from redwood.api import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
```

diego: also change docker example to `docker run -p 8080:8080` — starter listens on 8080. opened starter issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-app/issues/95

harper: added a tiny migration pointer to /docs/migration/sdk6-to-7 and a token-scope note: "Keys need inference:generate". updated KMS link. bumping CI.

ci-bot: ci/build-docs #527  snippet-check rerun: now passing \u2705 (https://ci.internal/builds/527/log)

sue: LGTM, product asked for a one-liner about hosted free credits in "first deploy". harper: can you add?

harper: added the hosted credits line and a short note about Dedicated rollback behavior. merging after staging smoke. thanks :rocket:
